name: TOP ROCKET Cordless Rechargeable Drill Machine Kit |   48V  Double Batteries | 3-in-1 Drill, Screwdriver & Impact Driver | Variable Speed Power Tool Set with Carry Case
description:
Complete your DIY, home improvement, and professional repair projects with the Cordless Rechargeable Drill Machine Kit. Designed for power, versatility, and convenience, this high-performance drill features drilling, screw-driving, and impact functions in one compact tool. Powered by a high-capacity rechargeable lithium-ion battery system and a pure copper motor, this cordless drill delivers strong performance with up to 45Nm torque and variable speed control for precision work on wood, metal, plastic, and masonry surfaces. The kit includes 2 rechargeable batteries, a fast charger, masonry drill bits, screwdriver accessories, and a durable carrying case, making it an ideal choice for homeowners, technicians, electricians, carpenters, and DIY enthusiasts.

Powerful cordless rechargeable drill machine
Pure copper motor for reliable performance
3-in-1 function: Drill, Screwdriver & Impact Drill
Includes 2 rechargeable lithium-ion batteries
Forward and reverse rotation function
